name: Steal an Object Show [TRIPWIRE]
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Steal an Object Show! A game where you have your very own Object Show that can be filled with a variety of Objects, from shows such as BFDI, II, ITFT, and much more!

🎮 How to Play:
🛍️ Buy your favorite Object characters
✨ Steal Objects from other players
💸 Earn cash and build your collection
📢 700+ collectable characters!

🖥️ Playable on desktop, phone, and tablet.
🗓️ New updates, and fun admin abuses, every saturday!

😲Made by real Object Show fans!

🎫Admin abuse every saturday from 3:30 PM CST - 4:00 PM CST!
